_comment: Per-unit stats. INCOMPLETE and deliberately so -- only values actually
observed are recorded, and everything else is absent rather than guessed.
The ROM table these come from has NOT been found. Searching for a strided
array keyed on observed max-fuel values failed at every stride from 1 to 40,
in both the sparse 24-slot id space the damage tables use and the compact
18-unit order the name blob implies, as u8 and as u16. Adding vision as a
second anchor at a constant offset also found nothing. The stats are
evidently not laid out as parallel per-unit arrays.
This does not block anything: the game DISPLAYS vision in the unit info
panel, exactly as it displays terrain Def, and reading values off the screen
proved the better source there too.

provenance.fuel_and_ammo: read from the live unit array in RAM (fresh, undamaged units)
provenance.vision: read from the in-game unit info panel

missing.how_to_fill: Vision is on the in-game unit info panel. Max fuel and ammo appear on a freshly built unit and can be read straight out of the unit array with units().
